scope: Existing open empty mailbox on Forever; read-only getter timing and passive native addon-profiler observation

getInboxNumItems.includes: Lua loop, timer subtraction and native getter; one compact output after the three trials
getInboxNumItems.excludes: Header, attachment, item metadata, provider scan, Flux publication, notification and populated-inbox latency

passiveObservation.counterRule: Nested native metric counters for _FluxUI in the same existing process/session; never summed. No reset or reload.
passiveObservation.control: No gameplay or mail operations requested during the observation. Existing crowded city scene, bags and mailbox open; desktop app focus changed between non-WoW apps. Other addons and user activity are uncontrolled.

safety.note: The helper only posted the listed /run read-only commands to the exact verified background WoW window. foregroundUnchanged=false in the timing submission reflects desktop focus switching between background apps; target guards passed at every command boundary.

decision: User requested in-game measurement before accepting a mail fallback delay. Empty inbox establishes only the stated fixed-cost and existing snapshot observations. The populated/cold-mail latency decision remains pending; no mail runtime fix was applied.
